definitions.explanation: Noun formed from {速|はや}い (fast), referring to how fast something moves or happens. Also used for speed as a magnitude in everyday and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {速|はや}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{競|きそ}う→競う：13767_kisou⟧。
⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{速|はや}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by the car's speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{速|はや}さ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧かなわない。
examples.english: When it comes to how fast she works, no one can match her.

notes:
Formed from the i-adjective ⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧ + さ (a suffix that turns adjectives into nouns expressing degree). Refers to the rate of motion or how quickly something is done.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{速|はや}さ: the speed of sound
- {速|はや}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧: to increase speed
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{留|と}まらぬ{速|はや}さ: dizzying speed (lit. too fast for the eye to catch)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧: speed, velocity — more technical and measured (e.g. km/h); {速|はや}さ is the everyday word
- {早|はや}さ: earliness — same reading but written {早|はや}, about timing (being early) rather than rate of motion
